# T-3: Rewrite draft interaction prompt

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Teach draft instructions to create and confirm goal, record pending QA, and ask closed-choice clarification before recording ambiguous answers.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Draft instructions require Q1 goal confirmation in manual flow.
- Clarification templates are present in English.
- Exact clarification templates are exempted from shared question-style and choice-format rewriting.
- Draft agent fixtures cover Q1 goal-confirmation storage and exact clarification templates.
- Ambiguous answers are not written as final answered QA before clarification.
- autoApprove records only sourced facts as answered and pauses/fails on true user-judgment gaps.
- prepare-spec ignores project-local qa.md templates and does not create qa.md for new flows.
- prepare/init e2e coverage asserts draft.json lifecycle artifacts and no active qa.md for branch, no-branch, and worktree flows.
- prepare-spec next guidance points to draft.json lifecycle, split draft review, and gate-draft.
- sdd-forge upgrade adds missing split draft review command ids to existing project configs.
- sdd-forge setup creates fresh profiles with split draft review command ids or documents/tests default-agent fallback.
